tool_args.rationale: The target horizon is 24.2, whereas the pilot spans only 0.16–0.48. A slow-horizon probe can distinguish the archived endogenous-reversal mechanism from positive, non-reversing alternatives and constrain its slow component.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-horizon adaptation from the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All horizons are short relative to the target horizon, leaving the slow timescale and long-run reversal poorly identified.
Fine short-horizon trajectories would be less directly informative about the slow reversal.
The pilot alone cannot distinguish these from slow adaptation at the forecast horizon.
